proposal.title: Mask-Invariant Value Pathway: Boosting on Observed Values with Mask-Information Removed via Synthetic-Mask Consistency
proposal.hypothesis: Under held-out shifts where P(M|X) changes but P(Y|X) is fixed, a classifier whose predictions depend on observed values but not on which features are missing (beyond the reduced information) will retain more mean average precision than native-NaN HGB or random-mask augmentation. It may lose some performance under in-distribution informative MAR.
proposal.mechanism: Native-NaN HGB routes missing values to a learned branch, which encodes P(Y|M). This encoding transfers across MCAR and MAR shifts but breaks when the mask mechanism changes (2406.16484v1). We propose to cut the path from the mask to the label. A teacher is trained on rows re-masked with known synthetic masks, and its pattern-specific pseudo-targets are averaged over mask draws. A student is then distilled to those targets, so it cannot exploit the mechanism that generated the training mask. Within a missingness pattern, the value-to-label relation is kept. The narrow assumption is that the shift affects only the mask, with P(Y|X) and P(X) fixed. The method fails when the mask itself causally carries label signal (informative-missingness gains are lost) and under MNAR where observed-value distributions shift strongly.

proposed_primitives.definition: For each training row with observed set O, the target is t(x_O) = mean over K synthetic supersets M'⊇M (anchor-preserving, mixed MCAR and grouped) of teacher p(y | x_{O\M'}, M' synthetic). The target approximates E[Y|X_O] under mask-independent mechanisms rather than under the training mechanism.

The student HGB is fit by regression of logit(t) on the masked inputs. The training mask indicator is shuffled within rows of equal missing count, which breaks the mask-to-Y association while preserving the amount of information.

relations.counterfactual_prediction: If raw labels are used instead, the student relearns P(Y|M), and the MNAR mAP drop matches native HGB.
Under MAR validation, there is no gain over HGB.
Without the shuffle, the gap between MNAR and reversed-MNAR performance widens.

assumptions: Only the mask mechanism shifts; P(Y|X) and P(X) are invariant.
Anchors 0 and 1 are observed at train and test.
No unlabeled target statistics are used. This is declared.
Synthetic masks are drawn only over already-observed entries, so no hidden clean values are used.
The training regime is fully defined: the teacher and student are both HGB, with fixed K=8.
strongest_prior_art: arxiv:2507.08280 MIRRAMS: overlaps on mutual-information invariance to unseen missingness shifts. It is a deep model with MI losses; this proposal is a tree teacher-student with explicit mask marginalization.
2406.16484v1: the analysis motivates the approach but proposes no learner.
2106.00311v2 NeuMiss: joint impute-regress, with no mask-shift invariance.
algorithm: Split 60/20/20 with seeds; take the masked training data X~ and M.
Draw K=8 anchor-preserving synthetic supermasks per row, applied to observed entries only.
Fit a teacher HGB on the stacked re-masked rows with labels y.
Compute t_i = mean_k teacher(x_i under M'_k ∪ M_i), with no access to hidden clean values.
Shuffle the indicator columns within rows of equal missing count; never pass explicit indicators.
Fit a student HGB regressor on logit(t_i), using clipped targets.
Calibrate with isotonic regression on validation MCAR20 only.
Evaluate on clean, MCAR20, MCAR40, MAR, and the three held-out tests.
proposal.baseline: Native-NaN HGB; HGB plus random-mask augmentation (K=8, no distillation); MIRRAMS-lite (MLP with MI losses) as the strongest constituent.
ablations: Distillation with raw y in place of t.
Compute-matched augmentation baseline with the same total number of trees.
proposal.metric: Mean average precision averaged across the three held-out mechanisms, with 10 seeds and paired bootstrap. Brier score and clean mAP are also reported.
proposal.falsification: Reject if the held-out mean mAP gain over the better of HGB and augmentation is below 0.01, or the 95% CI includes 0. Also reject if the ablation using raw y matches the full method, which would mean the effect comes from augmentation alone. Also reject if clean mAP drops by more than 0.02.
proposal.feasibility: About 40k stacked rows for HGB, roughly 60 seconds per seed on a CPU laptop; MIRRAMS-lite takes about 2 minutes.

validation_note: Revalidated saved response: proposed primitive names need not have a specific prefix; known arXiv aliases normalized; grounded edge endpoints included in component list. No semantic content or model calls added.
